leftEvidence.title: Jesus speaks of voluntary death and authority to take his life again

points.label: action
points.left: Jesus repeatedly says he lays down his life by himself and has authority to take it again.
points.right: Jesus comes into the locked setting, shows hands and side, breathes, and commissions.

points.label: Relationships
points.left: Father, command, love, sheep, and flock surround the saying.
points.right: Disciples, fear, joy, peace, sending, Spirit, and forgiveness surround the appearance.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus comes among fearful disciples, shows wounds, speaks peace, and sends them

payload.tension: The earlier saying names authority and self-giving; the later scene narrates embodied presence and commission without restating that explanation.
payload.title: Authority to take life again / risen presence behind locked doors
